_doc: The town's airships (Systems/Sky.cs), built and kept like the sea fleet (Systems/Fleet.cs: hull, crew, captains from green to legendary, repairs) but flown from the Sky Dock by any town that has one. The dock's first ship comes with it. Ships: cost, timber, crew, hull, wear a day aloft, repair gold a point, `speed` (days aloft for each day of road), `lift` (days of lift-crystal a full charge holds; `recharge` gold a day to refill at the dock), `guns` (ballistae: blows a volley), `agility` (added to the approach), `marines` (heroes it carries into a boarding), and `ceiling` (the share of storms it climbs above). Winds: the prevailing wind of the day (weather.json); flying with it is up to `wind` quicker, against it up to `wind` slower. The weather over the land a ship flies to holds it aloft `stormDays` more and burns lift, at `stormStep` chance a day by its step (fair, grey, foul, storm, tempest). Jobs: `patrol` circles the town for `patrolDays` (raiders seen `patrolHours` sooner, and fliers met on the way are fought), `scout` flies to a region and back and confirms what lies there (the council pays: it is the town's own eyes), charting the line it flew and the land round its end, at most `chartMost` days across, so the fog lifts there, `strike` bombards a lair the town has found: each volley that lands takes `strikeShare` of its strength, at most `strikeMost`, and its fliers come up to meet the ship. Foes in the air: each day aloft meets one with `meet` plus `meetPerRing` a ring out (more where flying menaces live, `menaceMeet` each); `foes` are the kinds met by ring, `power` plus `powerPerRing` a ring; a flying menace near comes itself at its power times `menaceShare`. A fight is three steps: the approach (d20 + agility + prowess against 10 + the foe's speed, `stormApproach` worse in a storm; won, the ship looses a free volley or slips away from a foe more than `evadeAt` times its worth), `rounds` of volleys (each side's blows land `low` to `high` of their worth; a foe's blows hit the gasbag `gasbag` of the time, taking lift instead of hull; a side breaks below `break` of its start), then boarding if the foe boards: crew (`crewFight` each) and marines (`heroLevel` a level) against what is left of the foe, on a d20 each side. Heroes in a boarding lose `heroHurt` of their hit points (never the last). Won, the crew share `prize` gold a ring, the captain learns `learn`, each marine earns `fame`, and a menace loses `menaceHurt` of its power. A ship with no lift left comes down where it is (`downed`): the crew and marines walk home in `walkDays` a ring, and the ship waits for `salvage` gold of riggers and crystal or is lost to the wilds after `strandDays`. A ship with no hull left is wrecked. Sky pirates raid the dock every `raidEvery` days (`raidChance`): the moored ships' guns, each watchtower's `towerGuns` and the watch (`watchFight` each) against `raidStrength` (more as the years pass); lost, they take `raidGold` gold and `raidLift` lift from a moored ship. The stand-in mayor keeps a ship on patrol, charges and patches ships, and builds a frigate when it can spare the gold.

foes.name: sky pirates in a black-sailed skiff

attackers.name: an ancient dragon
attackers.warn: Herders in the hills saw it first: a dragon out of {site}, circling lower each day. It will be over the town in {days}. Keep the airships moored, the watch on the towers and the heroes home.
attackers.repelled: The dragon of {site} comes down on the town in a storm of fire, and meets ballistae, arrows and the heroes on the rooftops. Bleeding, it turns for home.
attackers.landed: The dragon of {site} burns its way across the rooftops: {burned} go up in flames, and it carries off {gold} gold from the treasury. The townsfolk hid in the cellars, and none were lost.
attackers.called: Word comes that the dragon of {site} is dead before it ever flew. The town breathes again.

attackers.name: the sky armada
attackers.warn: A pirate sloop was seen spying from the clouds over {site}. The armada is coming for the treasury in {days}.
attackers.repelled: The sky armada drops grapnels on the town hall, and the defenders cut them loose one by one. The pirate ships limp back to {site}.
attackers.landed: The sky armada's raiders slide down ropes onto the town hall and are gone with {gold} gold before the watch can reach them.
attackers.called: The armada's ships never leave {site}: the isle has fallen.

attackers.name: the storm cult
attackers.warn: The storm-bells of {site} are ringing. In {days} the cult will call the storm down on the town.
attackers.repelled: The stormcallers' storm breaks over the town, and the heroes bring down the bound winds riding in its heart. It blows itself out over the fields.
attackers.landed: Lightning walks the streets: {burned} catch fire before the rain puts them out. Nobody is killed, but the storm cult has made its point.
attackers.called: The bells of {site} have fallen silent: no storm comes.

attackers.name: the cloud lords
attackers.warn: A cloud castle drifts out from {site}, and its shadow will lie over the town in {days}. The cloud lords mean to collect their rent.
attackers.repelled: The cloud lords' giants come down on griffons and meet the town's guns. Their castle drifts back to {site}, the rent unpaid.
attackers.landed: Giants climb down from the cloud castle and take {gold} gold as rent, smashing {burned} for the insult of being kept waiting.
attackers.called: The castle of {site} has fallen; no rent-collectors come.

carry: the {party} go aboard {ship} at the Sky Dock, {captain} at the wheel, bound up for {where}.
{ship} lifts the {party} off the Sky Dock mast and climbs toward {where}.
opened: {ship}'s ballistae sweep the landing before the {party} go down onto {where}.
stranded: {ship} does not come back for the {party} at {where}. They are on their own above the clouds.
searching: {ship} lifts off to look for the {party}, last bound for {where}.
rescued: {ship} finds the {party} on {where} after {search} of looking and brings them home.
Signal fires on {where}: {ship} picks up the {party}, thin and sunburnt, and turns for home.
harbour: A prisoner from a fallen isle gives up where {group} hide: {site}, deep in the clouds. Now the town knows where to strike.
ownWay: the {party} come home at last, having climbed down from {where} on rope and nerve. Nobody came for them.
launch: {ship} lifts off the Sky Dock mast, {captain} at the wheel, bound for {where}.
The riggers cast off and {ship} climbs over the rooftops toward {where}.
patrol: {ship} circles the town on patrol, {captain} watching the roads from the clouds.
storm: A storm catches {ship} over {where}; {captain} rides it out, burning lift to stay aloft.
evade: {captain} sees {foe} first and takes {ship} up into the cloud; they never close.
won: {ship} meets {foe} over {where}. {captain} wins the wind, the ballistae sing, and {foe} breaks.
Over {where}, {foe} come at {ship} and are shot out of the sky.
boarded: {foe} grapple {ship} over {where}; {marines} meet them at the rail and throw them off.
repelled: {foe} grapple {ship} over {where} and fight their way onto the deck before the crew drive them off. The ship limps on.
lost: {foe} savage {ship} over {where}; {captain} breaks off with the gasbag torn and the hull holed.
downed: {ship} comes down over {where}, her lift spent. {captain} and the crew set out to walk home.
wrecked: {ship} is wrecked over {where}. Her crew walk home with what they could carry.
salvaged: Riggers carry fresh crystal out to {ship} where she came down, and she flies home.
lostWild: Nobody came for {ship}. The wilds have her now.
struck: {ship} is home from {where}: her ballistae and fire-pots took the fight out of {site} ({share} of their strength).
raidRepelled: Sky pirates come at the Sky Dock by night; the moored ships' ballistae and the towers drive them off.
raided: Sky pirates raid the Sky Dock by night: {gold} gold carried off and {ship}'s crystal stolen.
